**Finding: compliant** (Section 10.5, paragraph p0065)

Section 10.5 selects New York law — the playbook's preferred governing law — and expressly excludes conflict-of-laws principles. The agreement contains no arbitration provision and no foreign or vendor-home venue anywhere (searches for "arbitration", "court", "dispute" and "jurisdiction" returned nothing), so there is no walk-away exposure.

The only gap versus the preferred position is that the clause is silent on forum: it does not designate exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County. That is a minor sub-element rather than a material failure — New York law governs and disputes will proceed in court under default rules — so it is noted here rather than redlined. If the clause is being touched for other reasons, we would take the opportunity to add the New York County exclusive-venue sentence.
